title: Surreal Crystal Sphere
description: A large transparent crystal ball rests on an ornate dark stand, displaying a surreal miniature world inside. Within the sphere, a glowing central orb emits neon branches and lightning, while waterfalls cascade from a cliff; outside the sphere a cloaked figure with an umbrella stands on a red rock ledge beneath a giant red sun, with a vibrant waterfall and dramatic cliffs in the background.
prompt: A large transparent crystal sphere on an ornate stand contains a glowing central orb with neon tree-like branches and lightning, waterfalls flowing from a cliff inside it. Outside the sphere a mysterious cloaked figure holding an umbrella stands on a red rock ledge in front of a giant red sun. Dramatic cliffs with a rainbow waterfall and stormy clouds fill the background, surreal fantasy digital painting with neon glows and vibrant colors.
